title: Toys Per Kilo Philippines: How Toyzoona Importer Works
description: A clear guide for buyers, parents, live sellers, and resellers who want to understand Toyzoona Importer's toys-per-kilo model in the Philippines.
summary: Toyzoona Importer helps buyers source imported toys by weight, making it easier to shop for volume, resale, gifting, events, and family hauls.

sections.heading: What does toys per kilo mean?
body: Toys per kilo is a bulk-buying format where buyers choose from available toy stocks and pay based on weight instead of buying each piece at a normal retail price.
This model is useful for resellers, party suppliers, live sellers, parents, school events, giveaways, and buyers who want more toys per trip.

sections.heading: Who is this best for?
body: The format works well for online resellers who need variety, families planning gifts, buyers preparing prizes or giveaways, and toy collectors who enjoy warehouse-style finds.
It is also practical for live sellers because mixed toy lots can create fast-moving product batches for Facebook, TikTok, and marketplace selling.

sections.heading: How to buy from Toyzoona
body: Join the Toyzoona Facebook group, check the latest live selling announcements, message the official page for current availability, and confirm warehouse visit details before going.
Toyzoona's regular buying window is Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine time, with live selling and auction activity announced through Facebook.

faqs.question: Where can I buy toys per kilo in the Philippines?
faqs.answer: Toyzoona Importer is based in Cabuyao, Laguna and promotes toys-per-kilo buying through its Facebook page, buyer group, live selling, and warehouse visit updates.

faqs.question: Are toys per kilo good for reselling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bulk toy buying can help resellers build mixed inventory, but profit depends on the current stock mix, sorting, pricing, and sales channel.

faqs.question: What time is Toyzoona open?
faqs.answer: The buying window shown on the website is Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine time.

title: Toy Reseller Starter Guide: What to Prepare Before Buying Bulk Toys
description: Practical steps for new toy resellers before buying imported toys in bulk from Toyzoona Importer.
summary: A new reseller should prepare a target customer, price range, storage system, posting schedule, and basic sorting workflow before buying bulk toys.

sections.heading: Start with a buyer profile
body: Before buying bulk toys, decide who you want to sell to: parents, collectors, teachers, party planners, gift buyers, or other resellers.
A clear buyer profile helps you choose toys with better resale potential instead of buying only based on excitement in the warehouse.

sections.heading: Plan sorting before posting
body: Bulk toys move faster when sorted into simple categories such as character toys, baby toys, educational toys, plush toys, roleplay toys, and surprise bundles.
Sorting also helps create clearer photos, stronger live selling batches, and easier bundle pricing.

sections.heading: Use content to sell faster
body: Short videos, live previews, bundle reveals, and before-and-after sorting clips can help buyers understand the value of your toy haul.
For Facebook sellers, consistency matters: announce live schedules, pin payment rules, and keep albums organized.

faqs.question: Can I start a toy reseller business with mixed toys?
faqs.answer: Yes, mixed toy lots can work for beginners if the reseller sorts inventory, photographs items clearly, and prices bundles based on condition, demand, and target customers.

faqs.question: What should I bring when buying bulk toys?
faqs.answer: Bring a phone with battery, clear budget, storage bags or boxes if needed, and a list of toy types that match your selling audience.

faqs.question: Where should new toy resellers sell first?
faqs.answer: Many beginners start with Facebook groups, Facebook Marketplace, live selling, local community chats, and short-form video posts.

title: Facebook Live Toy Buying: Why Schedules Matter for Bulk Toy Buyers
description: How live schedules, countdowns, and Facebook groups help Toyzoona buyers catch current toys-per-kilo availability.
summary: Live buying works best when customers know the daily open window, join the buyer group, and check official page updates before ordering.

sections.heading: Why live selling works for toys
body: Toys are visual products. Buyers want to see colors, size, variety, and current availability before deciding what to reserve or ask about.
Live selling also creates urgency because imported toy stocks can change as buyers visit, reserve, and purchase.

sections.heading: Use the group for faster updates
body: The Facebook group gives buyers a place to see announcements, live sessions, auction updates, and community proof around Toyzoona's toy inventory.
Joining the group is useful even if a buyer plans to visit in person, because stock and schedule reminders are often shared online first.

sections.heading: Best time to check
body: The website countdown follows the Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine time buying window.
Outside those hours, buyers should still use the official Facebook page to confirm next live selling schedules and availability.

faqs.question: How do I join Toyzoona's Facebook live buying updates?
faqs.answer: Use the website's Join Live button to enter the Toyzoona Facebook group and check the official page for current live selling announcements.

faqs.question: Does the website countdown use Philippine time?
faqs.answer: Yes. The countdown is calculated against Asia/Manila time for Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

faqs.question: Can I still message Toyzoona outside live hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, but replies and buying activity may follow the next available live or warehouse window.

title: Bulk Toys for Events, Giveaways, and Party Prizes
description: Ideas for using Toyzoona bulk toy hauls for school events, party prizes, gift packs, and family celebrations.
summary: Bulk toys can be turned into prize bundles, event loot bags, raffle rewards, classroom incentives, and family gift packs.

sections.heading: Build bundles by age and theme
body: For events, sort toys into age-friendly groups first. Keep baby toys, preschool items, pretend-play toys, plush toys, and action-themed pieces separate.
Theme-based bundles make distribution easier and make the event feel more organized.

sections.heading: Use mixed prize tiers
body: Instead of giving every prize the same value, prepare small, medium, and standout bundles. This works well for raffles, games, classroom rewards, and birthday activities.
Bulk buying helps because one toy haul can produce several types of prize packs.

sections.heading: Confirm availability first
body: Imported toy stocks change, so buyers planning an event should message the official page and confirm what categories are available before relying on a specific theme.
For time-sensitive events, build your plan around flexible categories instead of exact toy models.

faqs.question: Are toys per kilo good for party giveaways?
faqs.answer: Yes. Toys per kilo can be useful for party giveaways because buyers can create several mixed bundles from one bulk purchase.

faqs.question: Can schools use bulk toys for prizes?
faqs.answer: Yes, schools and event organizers can use bulk toys for classroom rewards, games, raffles, and recognition prizes, depending on age suitability.

faqs.question: Should I reserve toys before an event?
faqs.answer: For event use, message the official Facebook page first to confirm current stocks, schedule, and buying options.
